repositories.name: Start — personalized learning
repositories.use_for: Prepare a reading plan and identify learning needs before a contribution.
repositories.handoff: Browsing is independent of Symposium. Generating curricula in Start has its own configuration, authorization and optional provider costs.

repositories.name: Institute courses
repositories.summary: Course materials and their publishing infrastructure.
repositories.use_for: Find teaching materials and educational context for a presentation or workshop.
repositories.handoff: Reference materials only; Symposium does not import course records or run the course build pipeline.

repositories.name: Fundamentals textbook companion
repositories.summary: Python examples and figure-generation code accompanying Active Inference learning materials.
repositories.use_for: Study concrete algorithms and reproduce an example before describing its results.
repositories.handoff: The companion code is distinct from access to the textbook. Running an example does not establish scientific validity.

repositories.name: Generalized Notation Notation
repositories.summary: Notation and tooling for specifying, validating and rendering generative models.
repositories.use_for: Make model assumptions explicit and prepare model artifacts alongside a contribution.
repositories.handoff: Use the separate GNN pipeline and its model/backend admission evidence. No automatic Symposium model adapter is installed.

repositories.name: pymdp (Institute fork)
repositories.summary: Discrete-state Active Inference agent modeling code.
repositories.use_for: Develop and reproduce computational demonstrations for a contribution.
repositories.handoff: This is the Institute fork; its README identifies infer-actively/pymdp as upstream. Model execution and dependency selection remain a separate workflow.

repositories.name: Active Inference Ontology
repositories.summary: Structured terminology, identifiers, relations and vocabulary exports.
repositories.use_for: Clarify terms and document mappings when communicating research methods.
repositories.handoff: Vocabulary alignment needs human review and does not establish formal or scientific equivalence. Symposium does not perform automatic ontology mapping.

repositories.name: Working Groups
repositories.summary: Draft charters and operating procedures for collaborative work.
repositories.use_for: Prepare a group discussion and plan continued work after the Symposium.
repositories.handoff: Draft documents carry no authority until adopted and ratified. This link does not create membership or change organizer decisions.

repositories.name: Active Inference Journal
repositories.summary: Public recordings, transcripts, captions and associated metadata.
repositories.use_for: Find prior discussions and recordings to contextualize a contribution.
repositories.handoff: This is a content archive, not an automatic Symposium submission, acceptance or proceedings-publication service.

repositories.name: Journal Utilities
repositories.summary: Tools for transcription, transcript browsing and export.
repositories.use_for: Prepare accessible recording and transcript artifacts after permission to process and share them.
repositories.handoff: Separate hardware, services and configuration may be required. Symposium does not automatically send recordings to these tools.

repositories.name: docxology/template
repositories.summary: Reproducible research and document rendering pipeline used by the native abstract-book workflow.
repositories.use_for: Render the approved abstract-book project to PDF and editable Word.
repositories.handoff: Existing optional integration requires an explicitly selected Template checkout, compatible separate Python 3.14 environment and --render. Inspect final pages; rendering does not authorize publication.

workflows.title: Prepare research inputs
workflows.summary: Use learning resources to prepare research materials; validate the separate research-input scaffold. These inputs are independent of the approved public program.

workflows.title: Express and reproduce models
workflows.summary: Choose notation, vocabulary and computational tools for a contribution. These are manual handoffs to separate repositories, not automatic model execution inside Symposium.

workflows.title: Check the public program
workflows.summary: Verify the approved publication tree and inspect pending text offline. Structural integrity and content readiness do not establish source freshness.

workflows.title: Capture a private organizing snapshot
workflows.summary: Use the optional InstituteOS bridge only with separately configured SDK access and a reviewed mapping. Raw source records stay outside the public checkout. Start by inspecting the pull interface.

workflows.title: Review a candidate intake
workflows.summary: Compare two verified public trees before an organizer decides whether to integrate changes. The private report does not publish, infer renamed people or infer why a participant was removed.

workflows.title: Assemble and render the abstract book
workflows.summary: Use source-grounded dossiers, participant briefs and the optional native Template renderer. Run the documented private staging process and inspect final PDF/Word pages before publishing.

workflows.title: Optional OpenRouter research drafts
workflows.summary: Generate private research drafts only after separately authorizing provider transmission and charges. Public-sharing consent alone does not authorize every external processing purpose.

workflows.title: Optional Perplexity research drafts
workflows.summary: Use the existing Perplexity analysis workflow only with authorized source inputs and paid-provider access. Verify generated claims, citations and identity matches against primary sources.

workflows.title: Continue after the event
workflows.summary: Use public archives for context and draft group procedures for follow-through. Recording processing and sharing still require their own permissions and service configuration.
